description: Cat-25 subcategory consolidation: merge thematic duplicates from wave expansion (115 → 69 subcategories).

merges.name: Fitness, Endurance & Multisport
merges.primaryAppTa: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift / TrainingPeaks APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC; swim/bike/run load from multisport platforms.
merges.dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports, swim session logs (`swim:session`), triathlon TSS (`trainingpeaks:workout`).

merges.name: Health, Sleep, Wearables & Biohacking
merges.primaryAppTa: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs; HRV and body-signal sensors.
merges.dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`), HRV morning readiness (`hrv:reading`), posture/headache diaries (`body:signal`).

merges.name: Smart Home, IoT & Home Operations
merges.primaryAppTa: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — plus device sensors, security NVR, and appliance telemetry — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
merges.dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`), Frigate NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), washer/dryer cycles (`appliance:cycle`), robot vacuum runs (`vacuum:run`).

merges.name: Home Energy, Water & Utilities
merges.primaryAppTa: Solar inverters, smart meters, water monitors, pool/spa controllers, and hot-tub chemistry sensors via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
merges.dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), hot-tub sanitizer (`hottub:chemistry`).

merges.name: Media, Gaming & Entertainment
merges.primaryAppTa: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, podcasts/audiobooks, and board-game logs via HEC.
merges.dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), podcast listening (`podcast:session`), board-game plays (`bgg:play`).

merges.name: Home Lab, Network & Connectivity
merges.primaryAppTa: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, UPS (NUT), UniFi, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and speedtests via UF/HEC.
merges.dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`).

merges.name: Weather, Garden, Wildlife & Outdoor Life
merges.primaryAppTa: Personal weather stations, air-quality sensors, garden/plant sensors, citizen-science rigs, wildlife cameras, and weather-impact correlations via HEC and MQTT.
merges.dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, bird/animal detections (`wildlife:detection`), houseplant moisture (`plant:sensor`), seismograph/lightning (`seismo:reading`, `lightning:strike`).

merges.name: Pets, Vet Care & Home Life
merges.primaryAppTa: Pet GPS/activity trackers, smart feeders, litter boxes, pet insurance claims, and vet invoices via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
merges.dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), pet insurance claims (`petinsurance:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`).

merges.name: Personal Finance, Tax & Side Income
merges.primaryAppTa: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs, budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), SaaS subscription trackers, freelance invoicing, and tax-prep feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
merges.dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), SaaS renewal feeds (`saas:renewal`), freelance invoices (`invoice:unpaid`), tax document status (`tax:form`).

merges.name: Digital Life, Productivity & Learning
merges.primaryAppTa: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, PKM tools (Obsidian/Logseq), reading trackers, and language-learning apps via HEC scripted inputs.
merges.dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), Obsidian/Logseq graph stats (`pkm:graph`), reading progress (`reading:progress`), language-study streaks (`language:study`).

merges.name: Food, Drink, Kitchen & Cellar
merges.primaryAppTa: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors, homebrew fermentation, espresso/coffee logs, meal-planning/grocery feeds, and wine/spirits cellar inventory via MQTT and HEC.
merges.dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), meal-plan exports (`mealplan:week`), wine-cellar inventory (`cellar:bottle`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).

merges.name: Family, Baby, School & Childcare
merges.primaryAppTa: Baby trackers, family chore boards, teen homework/Canvas feeds, daycare check-ins, and nanny hours via HEC and mobile exports.
merges.dataSources: Baby feed/sleep logs (`baby:feed`, `baby:sleep`), family chore completion (`chore:done`), Canvas missing assignments (`canvas:assignment`), daycare check-in (`daycare:attendance`), nanny hours (`nanny:shift`).

merges.name: Sports, Skills & Athletic Training
merges.primaryAppTa: Strength/gym logs, climbing send trackers, racket-sport analytics, golf/UDisc rounds, snow-sport days, and yoga/Pilates session logs via HEC.
merges.dataSources: Gym lift logs (`gym:lift`), climbing sends (`climbing:send`), SwingVision tennis stats (`tennis:session`), golf scoring (`golf:round`), ski-day logs (`ski:day`), yoga class attendance (`yoga:session`).

merges.name: Music-Making, Instruments & Creator Analytics
merges.primaryAppTa: DAW session logs, instrument practice trackers, tuning stability sensors, and creator platform analytics via HEC scripted inputs.
merges.dataSources: DAW session exports (`daw:session`), instrument practice logs (`practice:session`), tuning drift readings (`tuning:reading`), streaming analytics (`creator:stats`).

merges.name: Chronic Conditions, Pharmacy & Adherence
merges.primaryAppTa: Medication adherence logs, pharmacy refill APIs, symptom diaries, and chronic-condition trackers via HEC and mobile exports.
merges.dataSources: Medication adherence (`med:adherence`), pharmacy refill status (`pharmacy:refill`), symptom diary entries (`symptom:entry`), prescription pickup confirmations (`rx:pickup`).

merges.name: Personal Life-OS, Digital Twin & Life NOC
merges.primaryAppTa: Cross-stream personal dashboards, self-forecasting journals, gamification scoreboards, and personal NOC/SOC-style service health monitors via HEC aggregations.
merges.dataSources: Cross-stream daily scores (`life:score`), self-prediction logs (`forecast:bet`), personal service health (`life:service`), breach-alert feeds (`breach:alert`), gamification points (`life:points`).

merges.name: Life Admin, Bills, Legal & Paperwork
merges.primaryAppTa: Passport/warranty trackers, utility bill feeds, estate-planning document registries, and voter-registration reminders via HEC scripted inputs.
merges.dataSources: Passport expiry (`passport:expiry`), warranty end dates (`warranty:end`), utility bill imports (`utility:bill`), estate document registry (`estate:document`), voter registration (`voter:status`).

merges.name: Dental, Vision & Preventive Care
merges.primaryAppTa: Dental cleaning reminders, vision prescription expiry, eyewear orders, and preventive checkup schedules via calendar/HEC feeds.
merges.dataSources: Dental appointment logs (`dental:visit`), vision prescription expiry (`vision:rx`), glasses/contact orders (`eyewear:order`), preventive screening dates (`preventive:screening`).

merges.name: Therapy, Mood & Mental Health
merges.primaryAppTa: Therapy session logs, CBT homework trackers, mood/journal exports, and mindfulness streaks via HEC and mobile exports.
merges.dataSources: Therapy session attendance (`therapy:session`), CBT homework completion (`cbt:homework`), mood diary entries (`mood:entry`), mindfulness streaks (`mindfulness:streak`).
